other_class.label: Tomato___other
other_class.note: max_images null means: match the median size of the target classes, sampled evenly across source classes.

field_eval.note: All PlantDoc tomato images are pooled and split here. With --field-dir, field train/validation images are mixed into training (each train image repeated train_repeat times so field photos are not swamped by lab photos); field test is never trained on.

calibration.note: The threshold is the stricter of: the lowest reaching target_answered_accuracy on lab validation photos, and (with at least min_field_images field validation photos) the lowest reaching field_target_answered_accuracy on them, capped at max_threshold. Field validation is small, so check the field test sweep too.
